name: Section Heading Bar
description: The full-width heading that opens every section of an entry page. A sect carrying className 'subHeadingLbl' wrapping a bare span. Observed 6 times on a single page with byte-identical props — treat it as a fixed atom, not a thing to restyle per section.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md 1.3 (Document Details, Party Details, Other Details, Delivery Information, Additional Amount, Summary)
usageNote: resolvestyles:true and the empty style:{} are carried on every real instance even though nothing dynamic is bound — keep them for consistency with existing pages. The heading is always the FIRST child of its section's sect container, at xs:12 regardless of the section's own width.
